title: P15.9-B5.4: /app/chat — Conversation layer on the canonical P15.8 contract (AppShell)
description: P15.9-B5.4 R2 — final residual closure on PR #100 (all R1 fixes preserved). R2-F1 per-session turn idempotency: pendingSubmit global slot replaced by pendingTurns Map<sessionId,{body,key}> — an ambiguous turn in A keeps its original body+idempotency key across SPA switches and is never overwritten or cleared by turns in B; a deliberate retry with identical session/body replays the original key, a new body mints a fresh key, single-flight preserved, committed POSTs never auto-retried (e2e proves K_A replayed after B completes, K_A != K_B, exactly one canonical pair). R2-F2 strict response identity/consistency: GET conversation detail verifies the returned session_id equals the requested id — a valid-looking foreign session fails closed IDENTITY_MISMATCH with zero foreign content rendered; the turn response envelope is validated via isObj BEFORE nested access; operator message and assistant reply must both be session-bound, carry distinct message_ids, echo the submitted body verbatim, and obey canonical user→reply adjacency (reply.seq === message.seq + 1); contradictory/malformed HTTP 200s are treated as unverified outcomes — composer + per-session key retained, canonical reconciliation refetch fires, no auto-retry, deliberate retry replays the same key and produces no duplicate pair (e2e: tampered operator body, tampered identity/ordering, null envelope all hold). Flake investigation: objectives.spec.ts 'policy HALT' (getByText('Policy halt committed') at :377 under 4-worker Promise.all double-click race) — non-deterministic pre-existing flake; passes isolated (356ms) and passed on identical rerun (168/169); unrelated to this diff, code untouched. Preserves all B5.4+R1 functionality; UI-only; zero backend/schema/dependency changes.
